title: Whether static methods can be overridden
answer: Static methods are not overridden because method overriding is runtime polymorphism on instance methods. When a subclass declares a static method with the same signature, it hides the superclass static method. Which method is selected depends on the qualifying class or the declared reference type, not on the runtime object. AeroTopo documents this directly with `Product.category()` and `Orthomosaic.category()`, where the subclass method hides rather than overrides the parent static method.
